description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value 2 or less, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast the nontoken artifact from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.
